scope: Login flow validation and post‑login UI elements
coverage_gap: Header title and shopping cart icon visibility after successful login are not covered by existing test cases.

test_cases.title: Validate successful login redirects to Products page
steps: Navigate to https://app.thetestingacademy.com/playwright/ttacart/
Enter username 'standard_user' in the username field
Enter password 'tta_secret' in the password field
Click the 'Login' button
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the Products (inventory) page

test_cases.title: Verify Products page header displays correct title
steps: After successful login, locate the header element on the Products page
Read the text content of the header

test_cases.title: Confirm shopping cart icon is visible after login
steps: After successful login, locate the shopping cart icon in the header
Check that the icon is displayed and not hidden

test_cases.title: Login fails with incorrect password and shows inline error
steps: Navigate to https://app.thetestingacademy.com/playwright/ttacart/
Enter username 'standard_user' in the username field
Enter password 'wrong_password' in the password field
Click the 'Login' button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline error message is displayed and user remains on the login page

test_cases.title: Prevent login submission with empty username field
steps: Navigate to https://app.thetestingacademy.com/playwright/ttacart/
Leave username field empty
Enter password 'tta_secret' in the password field
Attempt to click the 'Login' button
test_cases.expected_result: Login button is disabled or submission is blocked and an inline error appears

test_cases.title: Prevent login submission with empty password field
steps: Navigate to https://app.thetestingacademy.com/playwright/ttacart/
Enter username 'standard_user' in the username field
Leave password field empty
Attempt to click the 'Login' button
test_cases.expected_result: Login button is disabled or submission is blocked and an inline error appears
